scope: Current official QBFC request/response tables mapped to known qbXML paths. Literal character limits compared with executable US/DT string and ID limits; literal implementation versions compared with effective US operation/ancestor/field minima. Country qualifiers, nonliteral/numeric constraints and unmapped QBFC properties are not inferred. Differences require review, not automatic import. Lower table minima than enclosing operations/aggregates are contextual observations, not newly permitted protocol versions.
